propositions: The completion verifier returns a Dep record instead of CompletionVerdict when the verifier quotes a dependency-link from show_ticket tool results before emitting the actual verdict, because tolerant_parse selects the first parseable JSON object regardless of schema validation.

The selection policy in tolerant_parse is schema-blind: it prioritizes fenced blocks and first-parseable-object by document order without consulting the target model_cls, causing legitimate Dep records in tool output to win over valid verdicts rendered later.

The root cause is a selection policy, not a type wiring defect; the model emits a valid CompletionVerdict, but the extractor's first-wins heuristic picks an earlier Dep record that happens to parse as JSON.

This is the fifth recurrence of schema-blind selection causing gate failures (67ee/messianic-wild-dassie, artsy-chain-hold, dash-lure-slag, slit-rubble-braid), indicating the first-wins heuristic is insufficient and the protocol itself underspecifies payload disambiguation.

The fix requires schema-aware candidate selection in parse_structured (not tolerant_parse), combined with atomic directive + extraction changes, because the current no-prose directive actually increases failure likelihood if obeyed by models that quote tool output.

Native structured output on Claude is blocked by extended thinking compatibility constraints, making prompted-path hardening (sentinel channel + schema-filtered last-valid-wins + comprehensive invariant tests) the only permanent fix within architecture constraints.
